approach: Add one choke point: athena-data paths.rs gets a records-root selector (state dir from `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`, worktree <state>/records-worktree used only when it is a checkout of athena/records, else in-tree). Records::load_current and RecordSet::load_current use the worktree tip when present, else delegate to load(git, passed head). Switch the 'current' callers in the deliverable files, plus introspect::read_records, backtest.rs and xtask walltime.rs (file readers). Add the xtask records_reader_scan. Tests use one shared fixture (tempdir repo with record A in-tree, worktree with record B, ATHENA_STATE_DIR tempdir) and a macro that generates a worktree_<reader> and fallback_<reader> pair per reader. site.rs untouched.

risks.mitigation: The fixture sets ATHENA_STATE_DIR to a tempdir, runs binaries as child processes with the env set, and asserts the path is under it.

demonstrations.method: Macro-generated integration tests worktree_<reader> for: records_load_current, recordset_load_current, read_records, walltime, introspect_walks, status, forecasting, scoring, retry_carry, auditor, audit, proposals, backtest, land_pr. Each uses a fixture with record A in-tree and record B in the worktree and asserts B and not A.
demonstrations.observes: 14 worktree_ tests pass, each asserting the worktree's record B.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader still reading in-tree records/ or HEAD returns A and its worktree_ test fails.

demonstrations.method: Generated fallback_<reader> tests for the same 14 readers with no worktree; assert the result equals the old path (Records::load at head, read_records(root)).
demonstrations.observes: 14 fallback_ tests pass with results equal to the pre-change path.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader that errors or returns empty without a worktree fails its fallback_ test.

demonstrations.method: Test scratch_checkout_status_and_forecast runs the built binary (CARGO_BIN_EXE_athena) twice: `athena status --json` and `athena ask` with the fake agent from crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs, as tests/lifecycle.rs does. The forecast is the reading step's output (forecast quantiles written to the job record via scoring::reference). The reference checkout has records/ in its tree. The scratch checkout has none and the records sit in the worktree. The test asserts exit 0 and equal status JSON and equal forecast quantiles. Offline and fixture-based.
demonstrations.observes: Both commands exit 0 on the scratch checkout; status output and forecast quantiles equal the records/ run.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reader that needs working-tree records/ fails or yields empty history on the scratch checkout.

demonstrations.method: The change description lists the grep `Records::load|RecordSet::load|read_records|read_jobs|join("records")` hits using the classification in decision 4, mapped to test names. Compare against the test list.
demonstrations.observes: Every test name cited in the description appears in the list; every grep hit is mapped or explained as historical or not moved. The description cites the commands run.

demonstrations.method: Tests linked_worktree_backtest (cli) and linked_worktree_walltime (xtask) create a repo, run `git worktree add` for a linked checkout, set ATHENA_STATE_DIR to a tempdir with the records worktree, and call the readers from the linked checkout.
demonstrations.observes: Both tests pass and find the worktree records.
demonstrations.fails_without: Deriving <root>/.git fails because .git is a file in a linked checkout, so both tests fail.

demonstrations.method: The fixture sets ATHENA_STATE_DIR to a tempdir and asserts the worktree path is under it. Test scoring_ignores_passed_head passes a head unlike the worktree tip to the scoring and forecasting closures and asserts the worktree's results. docs/decisions.md records the rule.
demonstrations.observes: The test passes, and nothing is created under the real state root.
demonstrations.fails_without: A closure honouring the passed head returns main's records and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: xtask tests: records_reader_scan_reports_planted_read (writes a file under a tempdir, scans it, asserts a hit) and records_reader_scan_real_tree_clean (function-level allow-list).
demonstrations.fails_without: A scan ignoring planted reads fails the planted-read test.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks, then `git diff --stat` to confirm xtask/src/site.rs is absent.
demonstrations.observes: cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked all exit 0; git diff --stat lists no site.rs.
demonstrations.fails_without: A broken existing test, a format or lint error, or a site.rs edit fails one of these.

demonstrations.method: Read the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry in the diff.
demonstrations.observes: The entry names the reader move, the fallback, the allow-list, that the site generator is out of scope, and D111.
